hypothesis_source: v1 showed frozen 63/126/252 blended RS>=85 is worse than same-day eligible names at 5/10/20 days (date-EW net excess vs unselected -0.21%/-0.30%/-0.98%). Mechanism: accumulated relative strength marks stocks that already used the swing. Replacement: current relative demand, signal-day close-to-close vs the same-day SH/SZ equal-weight market. Reuse shipped market_outperformance_allowed. Gate and eligibility unchanged.
distinct_from_failed_representations: Not a RS percentile scan, not inverted RS (mean reversion), not 趋势模板, not 距年高, not VCP/cup/flag. Difference from v1: universe event is same-day market outperformance instead of trailing RS percentile. Difference from sequence-1 detectors: still no pattern detector. One mechanism change.
exposure: Training 2016-01-01 through 2022-12-31. Fills and 5/10/20-day labels must not cross 2022-12-31. 2023+ is exposure only if computed. Not a clean holdout.

universe.definition: On a gate-open day, eligible SH/SZ stocks whose causal close-to-close return beats that day's SH/SZ equal-weight close-to-close. Reuse shipped market_outperformance_allowed. Missing prior close is not in the universe.

selected: Gate open AND eligible AND same-day market outperformance.

windows.definition: Same as v1: T+1 open entry; scheduled exit is the open of the 5th / 10th / 20th subsequent market session. Limit-up, suspension or missing bar voids the signal (no roll). Labels past 2022-12-31 are incomplete.

contrasts.vs_market: Same-window SH/SZ equal-weight open-to-open. Geometric excess. Signal-day equal-weight (mean of daily means).
contrasts.vs_same_day_unselected: On the same gate-open days, eligible stocks that did not beat the same-day market. Real same-day set, not unavailable_not_in_frozen_inputs.

pass_fail.pass: Training 10-day and 20-day date-EW net excess vs market are not systematically negative, AND the same two windows vs same-day unselected are not systematically negative.
pass_fail.fail: This is the one allowed rewrite of the universe. If still systematically negative vs market at 10/20 days, stop the selector and mark the goal 阻塞. Do not scan a threshold on the outperformance gap, do not add a pattern detector, do not also rewrite the gate in the same round.
pass_fail.not_claimed: No live qualification, no clean 2023-2026 OOS, no parameter search.
